*   **Input:** Volume data, material properties, lighting conditions (represented as SH coefficients), and pre-generated random sample directions [S1].

The claim lists specific inputs: Volume data, material properties, lighting conditions (SH coefficients), and pre-generated random sample directions. The evidence confirms all these elements: 1) '3D coefficient volumes' and '3D coefficient texture' imply volume data. 2) 'data from the MERL BRDF library... to describe the material function M' confirms material properties. 3) 'SH coefficients for Lmi... are stored in 3D coefficient volumes' and 'light probes... depicted as Li' confirms lighting conditions represented as SH coefficients. 4) 'generate the random samples for the Monte-Carlo sampling on the CPU... and upload them to the shader' confirms pre-generated random sample directions.
